definitions: To repeatedly hit someone or something until they are forced into a particular state or place.
To force someone to learn or understand something by repeating it many times or by using punishment.
To shape something by repeatedly hitting it.
examples: They beat the metal into a new shape.
He tried to beat some sense into his younger brother.
The rain beat into the windows all night.
pastTenses: beat into (past simple), beaten into (past perfect)
